translations.app.title: Aegis
translations.app.subtitle: Protection and isolated analysis
translations.ui.notScanned: No scan has run in this session.
translations.ui.startService: Start the installed Aegis services in Settings, then refresh.
translations.dashboard.subtitle: A clear view of your protection and the evidence behind each result.
translations.dashboard.privacyDetail: Offline scanning is enabled by default. Files are never uploaded by this application.
translations.dashboard.connectedDetail: The desktop app communicates with the protection service over authenticated local IPC.
translations.dashboard.noGuarantee: A file without a detection is not proof of safety. Keep Windows Security enabled.
translations.dashboard.notFullAV: Post-change monitoring; preventive execution blocking is not included. Coverage errors remain visible.
translations.scan.subtitle: Inspect local files using hashes, signatures and static evidence.
translations.scan.fullNote: A full scan may take a long time. Use Cancel to stop safely.
translations.scan.warning: Samples are inspected as data and are never executed on the host.
translations.realtime.subtitle: User-mode file monitoring. Changes are inspected after they occur.
translations.realtime.watch: Monitored folders (one absolute path per line)
translations.realtime.exclusions: Excluded paths (one absolute path per line)
translations.realtime.notice: This watcher is not an on-access blocking engine. Files can execute before analysis completes.
translations.sandbox.subtitle: Run a program or prepared bundle in the supported MiniNT profile.
translations.sandbox.unavailable: Running arbitrary suspicious applications is unavailable in this build. No sample is executed by this screen.
translations.sandbox.reason: A licensed Windows guest, verified isolated storage and a trusted guest telemetry channel are required before interactive analysis can be enabled.
translations.sandbox.policyDetail: No network • no host shared folders • no clipboard • no device passthrough
translations.vm.subtitle: Live session controls and recoverable USER32 checkpoints.
translations.vm.notice: VM lifecycle controls require a validated guest image and configured virtualization backend. This build does not claim cross-version Windows compatibility.
translations.behavior.subtitle: Observed behavior and coverage from the current or last session.
translations.behavior.notice: Live guest process trees, API calls and remote windows are unavailable until a guest agent and verified display transport are installed.
translations.quarantine.subtitle: Review isolated files before restoring or removing them.
translations.quarantine.restoreWarning: Restore this file only if you trust it. The service will refuse an existing destination.
translations.quarantine.deleteWarning: Permanently remove this quarantined file? This action cannot be undone.
translations.history.subtitle: Recorded scans, detections and service events.
translations.settings.subtitle: Control appearance, privacy and scanning preferences.
translations.settings.privacy: Only hashes are queried when lookup is enabled and offline mode is disabled. Full files are never uploaded.
translations.settings.update: Signed signature updates are unavailable in this build.
translations.settings.about: Aegis • C++20 • WinUI 3 • Windows App SDK 2.5.1
translations.settings.restart: Language and theme previews apply immediately. Save to retain them after restarting the app.
translations.protection.admin: Changing protection, restoring and deleting vault entries require an administrator-authorized client. No elevation is requested automatically.
translations.session.notice: Guest programs run in MiniNT through the sandbox service. Cancellation ends the owned session. An incomplete run is not a clean verdict.
translations.session.path: Executable, prepared bundle or recovery.json path
translations.vm.limits: These controls manage the service-owned MiniNT session: start, cancel, checkpoint and resume. Checkpoints support the documented basic USER32 profile. Arbitrary hardware passthrough and full Windows compatibility are unavailable.
translations.behavior.limits: Session reports show observed findings, state differences, coverage and errors. They do not represent every possible Windows API or establish that an unobserved file is safe.
translations.services.notice: Service state comes from Windows. Starting/stopping follows the installed permissions; stopping antivirus protection requires administrator authorization.
translations.settings.limits: Protected static scanning is offline and limited to 32 MiB per file. Queue and scope limits appear in protection status. Monitoring configuration is changed on the Protection page.
translations.ui.busy: Too many requests; wait for the current operation.
translations.services.av.title: Antivirus
translations.services.sandbox.title: MiniNT sandbox
translations.protection.schedule: Quick-scan interval in seconds (0 disables this UI schedule; minimum 60)
translations.coverage.incomplete: Coverage is incomplete; review the recorded limits and errors.
translations.events.gap: Some events are no longer retained. Review protection history.
translations.quarantine.isolateWarning: Move the selected file into the protected vault? The original is removed only after its encrypted copy is verified.
translations.hash.title: Public hash databases
translations.hash.input: Enter a SHA-256 hash or a local file path
translations.hash.online: Allow this query to contact public databases
translations.hash.privacy: Only the SHA-256 is sent when enabled. Files, file paths and file names are never uploaded. Off: calculate the hash locally. Up to 1 GiB per file.
translations.hash.evidence: These results are supporting evidence. No match, a known-file record or an unavailable database does not establish that a file is safe.
translations.hash.keyNotice: Obtain a free Auth-Key at auth.abuse.ch. The key is kept in your Windows Credential Manager, outside the portable folder. CIRCL needs no key. A blank field does not replace a saved key.
translations.services.installNotice: Scanning requires both engine services. Installation, update and removal request Windows administrator authorization only after you click a button. The portable app itself needs no installer.
translations.services.removeNotice: Stop and unregister the two Aegis services? Installed versions, protection settings and the encrypted vault are retained for recovery. Analysis will be unavailable until you install the services again.
translations.services.cancelled: Windows authorization was cancelled. Service registrations were not changed.
